title: Julie's ARTery

services.name: Pottery class
services.desc: Discover the thrill of shaping clay on a pottery wheel as you learn the techniques and skills of this historic craft. In this 3 week class experience, students will learn the basic of centering, throwing pottery on the wheel, adding handles and details, and glazing. Get your hands dirty and join us for a wheel throwing adventure where you'll learn the art of pottery and leave with your own handmade masterpieces. The class includes clay, 2 firings, and glaze for 4-6 pieces. This class requires a degree of physical flexibility and strength in your hands, arms, and legs.
